fullPassage: A recent study by Bernheim, Garrett, and Maki suggests that the teaching of self-controlling techniques is important. Bernheim, Garrett, Maki They studied the influence on asset accumulation in adulthood of taking courses in household financial decision making in high school. These courses covered topics such as budgeting, credit management, balancing checkbooks, and compound interest. Some states never adopted these consumer educational programs, while others adopted them at different times, making it possible to compare subsequent saving across states and over time The researchers found that asset accumulation was higher in the states that had adopted these educational programs than in those that did not Moreover those who as children had been encouraged to save using a bank account saved more than others as adults. Similarly those who characterized their parents as having saved more than average saved more than others.

questions.passage: A recent study by Bernheim, Garrett, and Maki suggests that the teaching of self-controlling techniques is (A)[important / trivial]. Bernheim, Garrett, Maki They studied the influence on asset accumulation in adulthood of taking courses in household financial decision making in high school. These courses covered topics such as budgeting, credit management, balancing checkbooks, and compound interest. Some states never adopted these consumer educational programs, while others adopted them at different times, making it possible to compare (B)[subsequent / previous] saving across states and over time The researchers found that asset accumulation was higher in the states that had adopted these educational programs than in those that did not Moreover those who as children had been (C)[encouraged / discouraged] to save using a bank account saved more than others as adults. Similarly those who characterized their parents as having saved more than average saved more than others.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 중요한(important), 이후의(subsequent), 격려받은(encouraged)이 문맥상 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① important — subsequent — encouraged: 자기 통제 교육이 '중요'하고, '이후의' 저축을 비교하며, 저축하도록 '격려받은' 아이들.
❌ ② trivial — subsequent — encouraged: (A) '사소한'은 연구 결과와 모순.
❌ ③ important — previous — encouraged: (B) '이전의' 저축은 비교 시점과 맞지 않음.
❌ ④ important — subsequent — discouraged: (C) '단념시킨'은 문맥과 반대.

questions.passage: A recent study by Bernheim, Garrett, and Maki suggests that the teaching of self-controlling techniques is important. Bernheim, Garrett, Maki They studied the (A)[influence / irrelevance] on asset accumulation in adulthood of taking courses in household financial decision making in high school. These courses covered topics such as budgeting, credit management, balancing checkbooks, and compound interest. Some states never (B)[adopted / rejected] these consumer educational programs, while others adopted them at different times, making it possible to compare subsequent saving across states and over time The researchers found that asset accumulation was (C)[higher / lower] in the states that had adopted these educational programs than in those that did not Moreover those who as children had been encouraged to save using a bank account saved more than others as adults. Similarly those who characterized their parents as having saved more than average saved more than others.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 영향(influence), 채택한(adopted), 더 높은(higher)이 문맥상 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ influence — adopted — higher: 자산 축적에 대한 '영향'을 연구, 프로그램을 '채택한' 주, 자산 축적이 '더 높았음'.
❌ ① irrelevance — adopted — higher: (A) '무관함'은 연구 목적과 모순.
❌ ② influence — rejected — higher: (B) '거부한' 주에서 자산이 높은 것은 맥락 모순.
❌ ④ influence — adopted — lower: (C) 채택한 주에서 '더 낮은'은 결과와 반대.

questions.passage: A recent study by Bernheim, Garrett, and Maki suggests that the teaching of self-controlling techniques is important. Bernheim, Garrett, Maki They studied the influence on asset (A)[accumulation / reduction] in adulthood of taking courses in household financial decision making in high school. These courses covered topics such as budgeting, credit management, balancing checkbooks, and (B)[compound / simple] interest. Some states never adopted these consumer educational programs, while others adopted them at different times, making it possible to compare subsequent saving across states and over time The researchers found that asset accumulation was higher in the states that had adopted these educational programs than in those that did not Moreover those who as children had been encouraged to save using a bank account saved more than others as adults. (C)[Similarly / Conversely] those who characterized their parents as having saved more than average saved more than others.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 축적(accumulation), 복리(compound), 마찬가지로(Similarly)가 문맥상 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② accumulation — compound — Similarly: 자산 '축적', '복리' 이자, '마찬가지로' 부모 저축 습관도 영향.
❌ ① reduction — compound — Similarly: (A) '감소'는 저축 연구 맥락과 반대.
❌ ③ accumulation — simple — Similarly: (B) '단리'는 원문 compound interest.
❌ ④ accumulation — compound — Conversely: (C) '반대로'는 같은 방향 결과와 모순.

questions.passage: A recent study by Bernheim, Garrett, and Maki suggests that the teaching of self-controlling techniques is ①<u>important</u>. Bernheim, Garrett, Maki They studied the influence on asset accumulation in adulthood of taking courses in household financial decision making in high school. These courses covered topics such as budgeting, credit management, balancing checkbooks, and compound interest. Some states never adopted these consumer educational programs, while others adopted them at different times, making it possible to compare subsequent saving across states and over time The researchers found that asset accumulation was ②<u>lower</u> in the states that had adopted these educational programs than in those that did not Moreover those who as children had been encouraged to save using a bank account saved ③<u>more</u> than others as adults. Similarly those who characterized their parents as having saved more than ④<u>average</u> saved more than others.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② lower → higher: 교육 프로그램을 채택한 주에서 자산 축적이 '더 낮은' 것이 아니라 '더 높았습니다'.
det.analysis:
✅ ① important: 자기 통제 교육이 '중요하다' — 적절.
❌ ② lower → higher: 채택한 주에서 자산이 higher가 원문. lower는 반대. ← 정답
✅ ③ more: 더 많이 저축했다 — 적절.
✅ ④ average: 평균보다 더 — 적절.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ discouraged → encouraged: 저축하도록 '단념시킨' 것이 아니라 '격려받은' 아이들이 더 많이 저축했습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① household: '가정' 재정 의사결정 — 적절.
✅ ② subsequent: '이후의' 저축 비교 — 적절.
❌ ③ discouraged → encouraged: 저축을 격려받은(encouraged) 아이들이 더 저축. discouraged는 반대. ← 정답
✅ ④ average: '평균'보다 더 — 적절.

These courses covered topics such as budgeting, credit management, balancing checkbooks, and compound interest. Some states never adopted these ②<u>consumer</u> educational programs, while others adopted them at ③<u>identical</u> times, making it possible to compare subsequent saving across states and over time The researchers found that asset accumulation was higher in the states that had adopted these educational programs than in those that did not Moreover those who as children had been encouraged to save using a bank account saved more than others as adults. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ identical → different: '동일한' 시기가 아니라 '다른' 시기에 채택했기에 비교가 가능했습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① suggests: 연구가 '시사하다' — 적절.
✅ ② consumer: '소비자' 교육 프로그램 — 적절.
❌ ③ identical → different: 다른(different) 시기에 채택했기에 비교 가능. identical(동일한)은 반대. ← 정답
✅ ④ others: '다른 사람들'보다 더 — 적절.
